 Newcastle v Arsenal Match Preview
 Arsenal will be looking to extend their advantage over their title-chasing rivals, with the Gunners looking as though they're going to be the team to beat for much of this year's campaign. 
 Mikel Arteta's side have won their last six Premier League matches, which has seen them open up a sizeable gap at the top of the table over Manchester City, who struggled for wins shortly before the international break. 
 They're set to take on Newcastle this evening, in what should be a fiery atmosphere once again at St James' Park in the evening kick-off tonight. 
 The Magpies are winless from their last three matches, and have only won three of their opening ten Premier League matches. 
 They'll be well-aware of the threat posed to them by Arsenal today, especially considering that the Gunners have won the last four meetings between the two teams.

 ⚽ Harvey Barnes to have 2+ Shots @ 1.50 
 Harvey Barnes has had to wait his turn at Newcastle, having spent a long time in Anthony Gordon's shadow before Gordon left for Barcelona in the summer.
 The left wing is now more or less his. His main rival for the spot, Toure, looks a long way from being ready for this level.
 Barnes has taken more shots than anyone else at Newcastle this season, with 23 at 2.34 per 90. He's their biggest threat, too, managing at least two shots in three of his five Premier League games at St James' Park.
 Newcastle's form has been poor, but they still go for it at home. They've had 12 or more shots in four of their five home games and at least 16 in each of the last two.
